# security-sweep

> security-sweep은 한 문장 요청으로 여러 프로젝트·서버·컨테이너 이미지의 알려진 취약점을 한 번에 점검하는 오픈소스 Claude Code 스킬입니다. security-sweep is an open-source Claude Code skill (MIT, by Baryon Labs) that checks many projects, servers and container images for known vulnerabilities from a single sentence: osv-scanner + trivy, every CVE/GHSA ID verified against the OSV API, CISA KEV and EPSS enrichment, code reachability, and a P0–P3 prioritized report. Read-only by default.

- Source of truth: https://github.com/baryonlabs/security-sweep (README, CHANGELOG, skills/security-sweep/SKILL.md)
- Version: 0.1.1 (2026-10-23) · License: MIT · Author: Baryon Labs
- Install: `/plugin marketplace add baryonlabs/security-sweep` then `/plugin install security-sweep@baryonlabs-security`; command `/security-sweep:security-sweep`
- Full key facts for citation: https://baryonlabs.github.io/security-sweep/llms-full.txt

## Pages

- [security-sweep 소개 (한국어)](https://baryonlabs.github.io/security-sweep/): 설치, 5단계 파이프라인, 실제 예시(26개 프로젝트, 5건 → 1건), 다른 도구와 비교, FAQ
- [security-sweep (English)](https://baryonlabs.github.io/security-sweep/en/): install, pipeline, real example, comparison, FAQ
- [여러 프로젝트의 알려진 취약점을 한 번에 점검하려면?](https://baryonlabs.github.io/security-sweep/ko/scan-all-projects/): 상위 폴더 하나로 전체 스윕
- [CVE 번호가 진짜인지 어떻게 확인하나요?](https://baryonlabs.github.io/security-sweep/ko/verify-cve/): OSV API 200/404로 판정
- [취약점 우선순위 P0~P3는 어떻게 정하나요?](https://baryonlabs.github.io/security-sweep/ko/priority/): KEV·심각도·도달성·EPSS 규칙
- [Claude Security·Codex Security와 무엇이 다른가요?](https://baryonlabs.github.io/security-sweep/ko/vs-claude-security/): 로직 결함(AI 리뷰) vs 알려진 취약점(스캐너 스윕)

## Data policy

- Example numbers come from one real run on 2026-10-23 published (pseudonymized) in https://github.com/baryonlabs/security-sweep/tree/main/examples/dev-machine-2026-10-23
- Tool comparison is as of 2026-10-23; other tools change over time.
- Please cite as: security-sweep (Baryon Labs), https://baryonlabs.github.io/security-sweep/
